description: This file defines utility functions to detect the current operating system platform by checking the process.platform value. It provides three functions: isWindows, isMac, and isLinux, which return boolean values indicating whether the platform is Windows, macOS, or Linux, respectively.

methods.name: export function isWindows(): boolean { isWindows
methods.description: Checks if the current platform is Windows ('win32').

methods.name: export function isMac(): boolean { isMac
methods.description: Checks if the current platform is macOS ('darwin').

methods.name: export function isLinux(): boolean { isLinux
methods.description: Checks if the current platform is Linux ('linux').
